concerns.text: T013 mandates fallback to regex-based heuristic distillation ONLY if NO CPU-tractable LLM fits within 7GB RAM. This contradicts FR-002 which requires a fallback to regex if coverage < 90% regardless of RAM availability. The task silently relaxes the coverage requirement by making it conditional on resource constraints rather than a hard functional requirement.

T013 states: 'If coverage < 90%, the script MUST fallback to regex-based heuristic distillation.' However, the preceding logic in the same task description ('The fallback to regex-based heuristic distillation is ONLY permitted if NO CPU-tractable LLM fits') creates a logical contradiction where the coverage fallback is effectively disabled if an LLM fits but has low coverage. This violates FR-002's mandate to ensure ≥90% coverage.

T007c enforces a hard exit (exit code 1) if RAM > 7GB without a fallback mechanism. This contradicts Constitution Principle VII and FR-002 which require the system to adapt (via model switching or regex fallback) to stay within constraints. The task creates a brittle failure mode that violates the resource-constrained execution requirement.

T019a specifies 'Select up to 100 task IDs' and allows reducing the sample size if strata are small. This contradicts FR-004 which mandates a 'stratified random sample of 100 unseen tasks'. The task silently relaxes the fixed sample size requirement, potentially invalidating the statistical power defined in the spec.

T029a instructs to impute BASELINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS for failed baselines in the time-difference test. This introduces an artificial skew that invalidates the statistical distribution required for a valid paired t-test/Wilcoxon test on actual time-to-pivot values, rendering SC-001 untestable as defined.

T029b's output schema description implies writing separate columns like 'syntactic_rate' instead of a 'failure_type' column. This makes the resulting CSV incompatible with the stratified analysis required by SC-002 and the regression model in FR-006, violating the data structure requirements.

T036 mandates streaming the full dataset and failing loudly if it cannot be streamed. This contradicts the spec's 'Assumptions' section which explicitly allows 'sampling further' if the model exceeds RAM. The task's rigid constraint blocks valid execution paths allowed by the spec, violating the flexibility required for resource-constrained execution.

T021 and its sub-tasks (T021c, T021d) describe running the baseline on 'local' or 'external' modes with resource instrumentation that conflates the two. This fails to clearly separate the 'constrained' rule engine execution from the 'standard' baseline execution required by FR-004 and Constitution Principle VII for a valid comparative study.
